name: The Fulton Center
summary: Sleek retail center at a subway station featuring a circular layout with a spiral staircase.
demographics: The Fulton Center attracts a diverse urban demographic including affluent professionals working in the Financial District, young adults aged 25-45, and international tourists visiting Lower Manhattan. The trade area encompasses high-income Manhattan residents and commuters with household incomes exceeding $100,000, who seek convenient access to premium brands and quick-service dining options. Typical visitors exhibit sophisticated shopping preferences, valuing efficiency and quality, with strong demand for fashion-forward apparel, technology products, and grab-and-go dining that fits their fast-paced urban lifestyle.
description: The Fulton Center at 200 Broadway in New York City is a premier Westfield shopping destination that seamlessly blends retail, dining, and entertainment in the heart of Lower Manhattan. As part of the iconic Westfield portfolio known for delivering world-class shopping experiences across 12 countries, The Fulton Center offers visitors access to top global brands including Sephora, Apple, Zara, Uniqlo, and Swarovski. The center features modern amenities and time-saving technology such as click-and-collect services and Smart Parking, making it convenient for shoppers in a hurry while also providing the variety needed for an exciting all-day experience. Beyond shopping, The Fulton Center serves as a dynamic entertainment destination where guests can enjoy beautiful architecture and design while socializing with family and friends, along with diverse food offerings ranging from global cuisine staples to local eateries. Located in one of the world's most vibrant cities, this Westfield center enriches the New York community as a hub of inspiration, entertainment, and connection.
